person_made_it: Every channel, fader and count comes from Gordon's own events.json and letters, not stock copy.
emcee_who_is_speaking: Eric Francksen has the mic: their initials, Gordon's letter if he wrote one, then every shared channel.
what_time_of_day_is_this_room: A booth at 1 AM: console black, LED meters in each night's own color, the crew photo glowing above.
did_the_click_pay_me: Cue A/B blends two nights' art and chords, faders open friends, filters re-rack the year, counts tick live.
works_for_the_recipient: Phone first, readable with JS off, every night and friend reachable by plain links, noindex.
taught_me_something: It shows at a glance who Gordon shares the most nights with and how close each one is.
told_me_the_truth: Made posters are labeled IMAGINED; sound is an in-browser synth, never a fake artist recording.
weakest: Mobile crossfader shows one plate at a time; a gesture-driven full-screen deck would feel more like a real controller.
